subject.title: fix(onboarding): stop recommending tools setup cannot activate

question: Should the shared no-AI onboarding recommendation catalog include only installations that guided setup can detect and persist as a usable inference route, excluding otherwise supported advanced/provider/ACP flows?
rationale: The immediately preceding merged feature intentionally introduced a nine-tool cross-client catalog, while this PR selects a materially narrower eligibility rule for all consumers.

options.title: Adopt activation-only eligibility
options.body: Keep the four tools that the guided flow can verify and persist, so each empty-state card offers a path that can complete setup.

options.title: Retain broad discovery
options.body: Keep the broader catalog and revise the empty-state UX so advanced provider or ACP paths are not presented as guided check-again fixes.

recommendation.title: Adopt activation-only eligibility
recommendation.body: Keep the four tools that the guided flow can verify and persist, so each empty-state card offers a path that can complete setup.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared catalog and are the strongest available history signal for its intended eligibility policy.
